video_title: Luka Doncic is a BETTER SCORER than Kobe Bryant and Kevin Durant 🤯

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Raymond Felton compares Luka Doncic's scoring ability to Kobe Bryant
quotes.excerpt: Offensively, scoring-wise, forget the athleticism, forget the mentality for a second here.
quotes.quote: Offensively, scoring-wise, forget the athleticism, forget the mentality for a second here. I know he has a long way to go, but you are being disrespectful because we had a conversation that he is a clone of James Harden, and now you will not put him in conversation with Kobe Bryant.
